verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an onboarding flow that suggests starter Tasks and a wizard for connecting a local Agent. Neither is a first-run wizard that configures model credentials, messaging channels, or defaults. Self-hosting is documented through Docker Compose deployment, with no guided setup replacing configuration files, so this is adjacent material that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a first-run wizard walks me through model credentials, channels, and defaults instead of hand-editing config files
